serviceOff: The fan service is not running
serviceOffHint: The fan service (axia-fand) is not running. The kernel or the firmware keeps cooling the computer.
firmwareHint: These fans report their speed, but the firmware controls them. Axia DE leaves them alone.
noFansHint: This computer has no fan Axia DE can drive: it is cooled passively or by its firmware.
profileHint.auto: The kernel or the motherboard firmware decides the fan speed.
profileHint.quiet: Starts at 60 °C and stays low: the quietest choice.
profileHint.balanced: Starts at 55 °C with 30 %, 55 % from 60 °C and full speed from 65 °C.
profileHint.performance: Starts at 45 °C and reaches full speed at 60 °C.
profileHint.always: Never stops (40 %) and reaches full speed at 65 °C.
profileHint.custom: Your own steps: drag them on the curve below.
needAdmin: Only an administrator can change the fans.
systemControl: Let the system control the fans
systemControlHint: Off: Axia DE drives them with the profile below.
curveHint: Each step starts at its temperature and ends {hyst} °C below it (orange band), so the fan does not keep switching on and off.
curveHintCustom: Drag a point to change its temperature and speed. Each step ends {hyst} °C below where it starts (orange band).
boostHint: Full speed for a while, for example while compiling. The profile comes back by itself.
force: Run the fans at full speed
caseHint: Turns on what the case adds (its front USB ports and audio board). Takes effect after a restart.
caseRestart: Saved. Restart the computer to use the case's ports.
